# `foxglove automations runs delete`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](automations-runs.md)

```text
Delete one run and its chat. The run no longer appears in run lists. A run that is still in progress stops.

Usage: foxglove automations runs delete [OPTIONS] <RUN_ID>

Arguments:
  <RUN_ID>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
